name: jamf-read-only
description: Read-only Jamf inventory, device troubleshooting and compliance workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect Jamf inventory, device reports and compliance.
interface.longDescription: Read-only Jamf workflows for ChatGPT and Codex. This local package launches a stdio server; remote packaging supports hosted or registered connections. Tenant reads require separately configured server credentials.
defaultPrompt: Check Jamf setup status through this plugin.
List computers with names and serial numbers.
Investigate DDM status for a Jamf-managed computer.
Assess a Jamf Platform compliance benchmark.
